mapper.select:
select tt.id, tt.name, tt.pid, tt.type, case when tt.distribution_type = 0 then tt.role_name when tt.distribution_type = 1 then tt.charge_name else '' end as charge_name, tt.priority, tt.is_fixed, tt.create_user_name, tt.create_user_id, tt.create_time as createTime, tt.work_period, tp.name as phaseName, tpt.id as preTaskId, tpt.name as preTaskName, tdd.docsNames from template_task tt left join ( select a.task_id,a.template_id,string_agg(b.id, ',') as id,string_agg(b.name, ',') as name from template_pre_task a inner join template_task b ON a.pre_task_id = b.id and a.template_id = b.template_id group by a.task_id,a.template_id ) tpt on tt.id = tpt.task_id and tt.template_id = tpt.template_id left join ( select task_id,template_id,string_agg(docs_name, ',') as docsNames from template_delivery_docs group by template_id, task_id ) tdd on tt.id = tdd.task_id and tt.template_id = tdd.template_id
left join template_phase tp on tp.id=tt.phase_id
and tt.name like concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword} ,'%')
and tt.template_id like concat('%', #{params.templateId} ,'%')
order by
tp.seq ${item.sort}
${item.field} ${item.sort}
tt.create_time asc

select tt.id, tt.name, tt.type, case when tt.distribution_type = 0 then tt.role_name when tt.distribution_type = 1 then tt.charge_name else '' end as charge_name, tt.priority, tt.is_fixed, tt.create_user_name, tt.create_user_id, tt.create_time from template_task tt where tt.distribution_type = 0 and string_to_array(tt.role_id,',') && string_to_array(#{roleId},',') union select tts.id, tts.name, tts.type, case when tts.distribution_type = 0 then tts.role_name when tts.distribution_type = 1 then tts.charge_name else '' end as charge_name, tts.priority, tts.is_fixed, tts.create_user_name, tts.create_user_id, tts.create_time from project_task_sys tts where tts.distribution_type = 0 and string_to_array(tts.role_id,',') && string_to_array(#{roleId},',')

select tt.id, tt.name, tt.pid, tt.type, case when tt.distribution_type = 0 then tt.role_name when tt.distribution_type = 1 then tt.charge_name else '' end as charge_name, tt.priority, tt.is_fixed, tt.create_user_name, tt.create_user_id, tt.create_time as createTime, tt.work_period, tp.name as phaseName, tpt.id as preTaskId, tpt.name as preTaskName, tdd.docsNames from template_task tt left join ( select a.task_id,a.template_id,string_agg(b.id, ',') as id,string_agg(b.name, ',') as name from template_pre_task a inner join template_task b ON a.pre_task_id = b.id and a.template_id = b.template_id group by a.task_id,a.template_id ) tpt on tt.id = tpt.task_id and tt.template_id = tpt.template_id left join ( select task_id,template_id,string_agg(docs_name, ',') as docsNames,string_agg(id, ',') as docsIds from template_delivery_docs group by id,template_id, task_id ) tdd on tt.id = tdd.task_id and tt.template_id = tdd.template_id left join template_phase tp on tp.id=tt.phase_id WHERE 1=1
AND tp.id IN
#{phaseName}
AND string_to_array(case when tt.distribution_type = 0 then tt.role_id when tt.distribution_type = 1 then tt.charge_id else '' end,',') && string_to_array(
replace(#{chargeNameStr},' ','') ,',')
AND tt.type = #{params.taskType}
AND string_to_array(tdd.docsIds,',') && string_to_array(
replace(#{docsNameStr},' ','') ,',')
AND tt.is_fixed = #{params.isFixed}
and tt.name like concat('%', #{params.taskName} ,'%')
and tt.template_id like concat('%', #{params.templateId} ,'%')
order by tt.create_time asc
